!theme plain
title Software Component Diagram

package \"Client Application (React)\" {
 [Main App (App.tsx)]

 package \"UI Components\" {
 [Editor]
 [Chat]
 [Drawing Board]
 [File Explorer]
 }

 package \"State Management (Context)\" {
 [Socket Context]
 [File Context]
 [Chat Context]
 }

 package \"API Services\" {
 [Piston API Service]
 [Pollinations API Service]
 }

 [Main App] -down-> [UI Components]
 [UI Components] .down.> [State Management (Context)] : uses
 [State Management (Context)] .down.> [API Services] : triggers
}

package \"Backend Server (Node.js)\" {
 [HTTP Server (Express)]
 [WebSocket Server (Socket.IO)] as WSServer

 package \"Real-time Logic\" {
 [User & Room Mgmt]
 [Event Handlers]
 }

 [WSServer] -down-> [Real-time Logic]
}

cloud \"External Services\" {
 [Piston API]
 [Pollinations API]
}

' --- Vertical Relationships ---
[State Management (Context)] -down-> [WSServer] : WebSocket Connection
[API Services] -down-> [External Services] : HTTP Requests
[HTTP Server (Express)] .up.> [Main App] : Serves Static Files
